title: Energy Vault Appoints Senior Capital Markets Veteran Nitin Dahiya from BlackRock as Chief Financial Officer as its Global Energy Infrastructure Growth Accelerates
summary: Energy Vault appoints Nitin Dahiya as CFO to enhance its financial leadership and support global growth in renewable energy infrastructure.
body_markdown: *Mr. Dahiya brings over two decades experience in institutional investment, corporate finance and capital markets as Energy Vault deepens its financial leadership and global capital formation capabilities*
